```plato
    // One level of Loop subdivision: the 1-to-4 topology of a full edge split,
    // with the Loop position rules substituted for the midpoints.
    LoopSubdivided(self: TriangleMesh3D): TriangleMesh3D
    {
        var topology = self.TopologyOf;
        var boundary = self.BoundaryVertexFlags(topology);
        var neighbors = self.VertexNeighborTable(topology);
        var refined = self.SplitEdges(topology, AllEdgesMask(topology));
        var moved = self.Positions.Count
            .MapRange(v => self.LoopVertexPoint(topology, neighbors, boundary, v));
        var inserted = topology.EdgeCount.MapRange(e => self.LoopEdgePoint(topology, e));
        return (moved.Concatenate(inserted), refined.Faces);
    }
```
